answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 11216 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum Iam depressed because i have been shifted to another branch of my work place (because an employee has left suddenly)which is far to travel.besides i want to stay in my work place.Please suggest a dua or a quranic aayah that i can recite so that they will find a suitable replacement soon.(I follow the Shafi madhab) JazakAllahu Khair Question: Assalamu alaikum Iam depressed because i have been shifted to another branch of my work place (because an employee has left suddenly)which is far to travel.besides i want to stay in my work place.Please suggest a dua or a quranic aayah that i can recite so that they will find a suitable replacement soon.(I follow the Shafi madhab) JazakAllahu Khair Answer ID: 11216 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 413/K=40/K/1430) (1) Recite ya Latif ( یا لطیف ) 111 times after Isha Salah with durood 11 times before and after, then pray to Allah. (2) Memorize the below dua and recite it after obligatory salah and other times: اللھم الطف بي تیسیر کل عسیر فإن تیسیر کل عسیر علیک یسیر وأسئلک الیسر والمعافاۃ في الدنیا والآخرۃ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
